title: Lumo oat drink FGD (invented fixture)
hypotheses: Busy commuters choose an oat drink for convenience, not taste.
A 'no added sugar' claim is believed only with a short ingredient list.

questions.en: Please introduce yourself and say what you usually drink in the morning.
questions.zh: 请简单介绍一下自己，平时早上喝什么？

questions.en: Moderator to explain the recording and the viewing room.
questions.zh: 主持人说明录音和观察室。

questions.en: Can you walk me through a typical weekday morning?
questions.zh: 能说说你平常工作日早上是怎么过的吗？

probes.en: Where do you buy your morning drink?
probes.zh: 早上喝的东西一般在哪里买？

questions.en: What matters most to you in a breakfast drink?
questions.zh: 早餐饮品你最看重什么？

probes.en: How do you judge whether a drink is really healthy?
probes.zh: 怎么判断一个饮品是真的健康？

questions.en: What does 'healthy' mean to you for a drink?
questions.zh: 对你来说，一款饮品健康是什么意思？

questions.en: Which oat drink brands have you tried, and how do they compare?
questions.zh: 你们喝过哪些燕麦饮品牌？觉得它们怎么样？

questions.en: What comes to mind when you hear Lumo?
questions.zh: 听到露慕，你会想到什么？

questions.en: What does 'healthy' mean to you for a drink?
questions.zh: 对你来说，一款饮品健康是什么意思？

questions.en: Which brand would you trust most for a 'no added sugar' claim, and why?
questions.zh: 说到零添加糖，你最相信哪个品牌？为什么？

questions.en: Here are two routes, A and B. Which one would you choose?
questions.zh: 这里有两个方向，A和B，你们会选哪一个？

questions.en: If Lumo launched route B in a bigger bottle, would you buy it every week?
questions.zh: 如果露慕推出B方向的大瓶装，你们会每周都买吗？

questions.en: What would make the 'no added sugar' claim believable?
questions.zh: 怎样才能让你相信零添加糖这个说法？
